newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shangri-La mulls listing of China unit.
newsitem.headline: Shangri-La mulls listing of China unit.

text.p: Hong Kong hotelier Shangri-La Asia Ltd said on Thursday its 50 percent-owned China World Trade Center Ltd (CWTC) was considering raising funds by seeking a listing but no final decision had yet been made.
Shangri-La Asia said CWTC had been considering various funding alternatives including a possible listing.
"CWTC applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission last year and again this year for approval for an overseas listing of CWTC," the statement said.
It added, "No final decision has been made in the matter, that all alternatives are still being considered and that the structure of any possible listing has yet to be formulated and assessed."
China-incorporated CWTC engages in hotel ownership and operation and property investment.
